description: Library preset (no lockfile, all updates in one PR; updates only up to the version that resolves)

packageRules.description: Majors (and 0.x minors) go into the grouped PR without approval: they are only offered up to the version that resolves together with all other dependencies
analyzer is widened instead of bumped, so older analyzer versions stay allowed (the post-upgrade step merges the widened range into one pub range)
